draft_key_information_units.information: Headline financial performance: Group net turnover decreased 4% to EUR 25.99 million with a loss of EUR 643,000 (compared to EUR 2.37 million loss prior year). Parent company net turnover decreased 6% to EUR 21.92 million with a loss of EUR 552,000 (compared to EUR 1.34 million loss prior year).

Regional revenue changes: Americas region turnover decreased 14% to EUR 14.17 million (55% of group turnover), Europe region turnover increased 17% to EUR 10.0 million, Asia/TMiddle East/Africa region turnover decreased 5% to EUR 1.8 million.

Impact of geopolitical factors: Ongoing US-China trade tensions affect global electronics markets but currently have no significant negative impact on group sales; import duties remain unchanged for microwave equipment imported to the US from the EU, while Aranet products face a 15% duty; Canada branch established to mitigate supply chain and customs cost risks.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Vadības ziņojums (ģeopolitiskie riski un muitas nodokļi)

draft_key_information_units.information: Product development and strategic focus: Continued investment in new product development (micro-wave data transmission, IoT solutions like Aranet), initiation of faster-to-implement product development initiatives, and market research to identify problem areas for product modifications and next-generation technology prototypes.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Vadības ziņojums (izpēte un attīstība, nākotnes perspektīvas)

draft_key_information_units.information: Liquidity and cash flow position: Group cash balance increased to EUR 4.81 million (up EUR 2.6 million); parent company cash balance increased to EUR 2.84 million (up EUR 1.35 million); unused EUR 4.95 million credit line with Luminor Bank; both group and parent company reported positive operating cash flow.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Vadības ziņojums (naudas līdzekļu atlikums), Naudas plūsmu pārskats

draft_key_information_units.information: Segment and geographic revenue distribution: Business divided into two segments - SAF products (CFIP, Integra, Spectrum Compact, Aranet) dominating revenue, and other products (antennas, cables, OEM); exports account for 97% of group turnover (EUR 25.24 million) and 96% of parent turnover (EUR 21.06 million), with products sold in 87 countries.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Vadības ziņojums (eksports), 17. piezīme (segmenti un ģeogrāfiskā sadalījuma informācija)

draft_key_information_units.information: Loss explanation and outlook: Management characterizes the reporting year's loss as temporary and not impacting long-term stability; focuses on strategic market niches for wireless data transmission products and specialized solutions; positive net cash flow from operations supports ongoing operations despite the loss.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Vadības ziņojums (zaudējumu situācijas vērtējums un nākotnes plāni)

draft_key_information_units.information: Proposal to cover loss: Board of Directors proposes to cover the reporting year's loss from retained earnings of previous years.

evaluation.selection_rationale: These units cover material summary-level content required for a concise financial report summary: headline financial performance (D1), major regional changes (D2), key external risks and mitigations (D3), core strategic initiatives (D4), liquidity position (D5), segment/geographic structure (D6), loss context and outlook (D7), and proposed loss coverage (D8). Each unit represents an independently omittable theme supported by the source report. Routine boilerplate (governance, remuneration, risk lists, accounting policies) is excluded per instructions. The units align with prioritized elements (performance, changes, drivers, segments, liquidity, strategy, events) and reflect salience from the reference summary where applicable.
